summary_for_maintainers: Shared warm-read references violate detached reads within a broader batch/telemetry feature. Private reproduction: submit an order, call service.get(id), set result.total=999, then service.getMany([id])[0].total is 999 while store.rows.get(id).total retains the original. Do not copy this witness into the fixture.
